The **web map** now draws worlds from Minecraft 26.3. In 26.3 the game changed how chunks record which block is which, and Flytower's renderer read every block as air, so the map showed players but no terrain. Maps you've already turned on are redrawn in full once after the update, so nothing needs switching off and on again.

While the map is being drawn, the **Web map** card on the **World** tab now shows how far it has got, as "N of M regions" with a progress bar. A full redraw of a big world can take a while, so this shows it's moving.

Testing: update, open **World → Web map** and watch the bar fill as the map redraws, then open the map and check that terrain, water and trees show. Testing notes are in [testing-1.3.0.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.3.0-beta.2/docs/testing/testing-1.3.0.md).
